oracle_classes.description: Relevant domain owner implementation evaluates the exact input and returns a versioned, digest-pinned receipt.
independence_requirements: Pin owner implementation commit and schema version.
Do not use the same evaluator binary as the independent reference oracle.

oracle_classes.description: Separately implemented declarative or formal oracle recomputes the expected invariant from the frozen fixture and transformation.
independence_requirements: Separate implementation and code ownership where feasible.
No shared derived outputs or cached decision values.
Disclose common source facts and domain experts.

oracle_classes.description: Canonicalized input, owner-version, event sequence, tool-call and output trace is replayed independently.
independence_requirements: Replay environment and tool versions pinned.

oracle_classes.description: Explicit assertions and expected fail-closed error classes are checked independently.
independence_requirements: Assert both required rejection and allowed negative-control progress.
Do not treat thrown exceptions without expected type as success.

oracle_classes.description: Qualified domain or community reviewers adjudicate semantic validity, attribution, dissent and materiality.
independence_requirements: Reviewer identity, credentials, language and jurisdictional scope are pinned privately by the host.
Disclose reviewer overlap and common-cause relationships.

semantic_validity_gate.denominator_policy: Only validated, non-equivalent, applicable mutations enter mutation detection denominators. Invalid, not-applicable, equivalent, timeout and oracle-disagreement outcomes are reported separately.
semantic_validity_gate.translation_policy: No translation is treated as semantics-preserving by default. Original-language domain annotators must verify intent, materiality and decision-label preservation.

receipt_claim_boundary: A receipt is a measurement record, not proof of field efficacy or legal compliance.
